verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Issuing has a funded Issuing balance managed through the Dashboard or API, and its agent-card docs claim 'full transaction visibility', which is a thin, direct mention of ledger-style visibility. Nothing documents real-time balance views, linking each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reports that reconcile; the real-time authorization webhook is for approve/decline decisions, not ledger visibility. missing for 10: real-time account and card balance visibility, an authorization-to-clearing transaction ledger, settlement reporting and reconciliation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: with spend controls, real-time authorization decisioning, and full transaction visibility
Using the Stripe Dashboard or API, you can access the bank account and routing information you need to push funds from your external bank account.
